questions.question: What is a subspace $U\subseteq V$?
options: A subset that contains no zero vector.
A subset of $V$ that is itself a vector space.
Any subset of $V$.
A set of scalars unrelated to $V$.
questions.explanation: A subspace $U\subseteq V$ is a subset that is itself a vector space under the same operations as $V$.
